HOW TO PLAY

Three steps to master the grid.

Simple to learn. Challenging to perfect.

01 / REVEAL

Open safe cells

Tap a cell to reveal what's underneath. Keep an eye out for mines.

02 / DEDUCE

Follow the numbers

Use the numbers to work out how many mines are in the neighboring cells.

03 / FLAG

Mark the mines

Place flags where you suspect mines and clear all safe cells to win.
